note: Pins for the Rust-tuned overlay (crates/portlight-sim/data/tuned_overlay.json). Generated by tools/parity/pin_tuned.py from a sweep of every parity script; never edited by hand. Each entry is category rust-tuned, names its check as tuned_<check> (so no pair is in both files) and pins exact leaf paths with the Python value and the Rust value of one comparison: oracle (narrow snapshot), oracle_wide (wide-only keys such as the contract board), gamesession, roundtrip (Rust load of the Python save against Rust load of the Rust save), roundtrip_rust_save (Rust's save, loaded by Python and by Rust) and roundtrip_python_save (Python's save, loaded by Python and by Rust). A path whose two values are equal is refused. The Python game at the pinned commit does not know the overlay. A build with the python-base feature compiles the overlay out and does not read this file, and the oracle job runs it against every script with only the entries in expected_divergences.json. The same (script, check) pair is never in both files. Old saves reprice on load to the tuned values.
